title: Digital Out of Home / Plaza Screens
slide_intent: Evaluate a campaign from pedestrian distance so identity choices survive a visually busy setting.
strategic_value: Repeated blue fields and Spectrum signatures can connect scattered plaza placements amid competing signs.
demonstration: A 15-second wide plaza visualization places the campaign on multiple screens around L.A. Live, with people, buildings and other advertising visible.
practical_value: Judge brand visibility at the scale of the whole site rather than only in an isolated artwork preview.

content_islands.name: Plaza context
content_islands.spec: Keep the wide daytime plaza view, architecture, pedestrians and neighboring advertisements.

content_islands.name: Distributed campaign
content_islands.spec: Show the related Spectrum blue panels and photographic advertising on the dispersed vertical and horizontal screens.
